extensionDescription.message: Shows TypeSafe Jev priority scores beside messages in Gmail's Primary inbox without modifying Gmail data.

optionsSubtitle.message: Your API key and filter settings are stored only in this browser. Only a de-identified role and email content that passes safety checks are sent to TypeSafe.

privacyNoticeBody.message: For scoring, address headers are removed and up to 2,500 characters of the latest email content are sent to TypeSafe servers in the United States after identifiers are masked. Messages containing high-risk data, such as patient schedules or rosters, explicit patient names or IDs, resident registration numbers, card, account, passport, authentication, or login credentials, and messages that fail the final safety scan are locked (🔒) and not sent. Check your organization's privacy policy before use.

recipientRoleHint.message: Used only to assess importance, without your name or organization

selfEmailsHint.message: Comma-separated. Used only in this browser to replace your replies with [SELF]; never sent to TypeSafe

patientSendersHint.message: Comma or line separated. All messages from listed senders are locked. Use “@domain” carefully because it locks the entire domain.

settingsSaved.message: Saved. Refresh Gmail to apply the changes.

connectionSuccess.message: Connected ($MODEL$). Action probability for the test sentence: $SCORE$

popupSummary.message: Primary inbox · last 7 days · high-risk private email is locked 🔒 · identifiers masked · Gmail data is never changed

cacheCleared.message: Cleared $COUNT$ cached scores. Refresh Gmail to rescore.

configureApiKeyFirst.message: Enter your TypeSafe API key in Settings first.
